articles.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
articles.description: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
articles.description: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
articles.description: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
articles.description: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
articles.description: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends October 16
articles.description: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit end on October 16. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 in Boston.

articles.title: AI agents are coming to Rivian’s cars
articles.description: We'll likely learn more about how this will work at the company's upcoming "AI & Autonomy Day" event in December.
articles.author: Sean O'Kane

articles.title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
articles.description: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.
articles.author: Lauren Forristal

articles.description: Last day to join TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Join 10,000+ tech leaders for a day of connections and insights. Save 75% on your pass now.

articles.title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
articles.description: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.
articles.author: Sarah Perez
